subject.why: It is clearly a wooden island torch with a bright flame, complete with the requested rope wrap and red bead.

category.why: The torch floats in the air with a slight tilt against a single-color gradient background with concentric rings.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, frames, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The torch is well-centered with ample, even margins on all sides.

colour.why: The palette is saturated and vivid, and the warm torch contrasts cleanly against the rich purple background.

detail.why: Features clean, simplified forms without noisy wood grain, scratches, or micro-textures.

style.why: Matches the reference style with smooth chunky volumes, satin sheen, and clean 3D rendering without outlines.
